purpose: Fit one new two-output actor from verified native fixture actions and evaluate whether it can reproduce moving turns and rest in physical closed loop.

collection.use: Offline native diagnostic targets only; separate held-out physical validation.

stop: A failed collection or nonfinite weights blocks their consumers. A failed evaluation prevents adoption. Timeouts are recorded. This pilot has one attempt per stage.
production: Live adoption requires a qualified motor and a separately learned chooser. Recordings stay explicit. Motor 336 and protected assets are outside this study.
